brief.t: START HERE: Lock Roon Body's immediate 1,500-unit run into the next available floor slot and send Josh firm start and completion dates now.

ACT NOW 1: Josh confirmed PLL has all inputs for the immediate Roon Body run and remains backlogged. He has waited 2 calendar days for a production timeline, and no follow-through is visible. Send: Josh, I am locking the immediate 1,500-unit run into the next available floor slot now and will send you firm start and completion dates today.

ACT NOW 2: Polo container EMCU8614105 has been pending customs exam since October 10, now 8 calendar days. Price Transfer's request for Aidan's broker contact remains unanswered, and no release is visible. Send: Roxi, the broker contact is [NAME, EMAIL, PHONE]. Please confirm the exam status, release status, current charges, and earliest pickup time today.

ACT NOW 3: Marcello requested 500 additional TALOVA lip balms after a stockout and proof of delivery for the prior 15,000 units. No reply or resolution is visible 9 calendar days later. Send: Marcello, I am confirming stock or build timing for the additional 500 and proof of delivery for the prior 15,000 now. I will give you both answers today.

next: Recommendation: Commit Roon Body's production dates first, send Price Transfer the Polo broker contact second, then close TALOVA's stockout.
Scheduled: 12 other known operational items, none confirmed urgent. The nearest verified delivery is FedEx shipment 533066816125 on October 19.
